verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order and hierarchy (eyebrow, headline, body, orange CTA, ships note, legal), but it is cramped: the header band is squeezed, the gaps between headline, body and CTA are tight, the body copy is almost as heavy as the headline, and the legal text is too small to read. B drops the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and shrinks the CTA to a tiny, unreadable pill in the right column. That buries the CTA under oversized body copy on the left. The legal text and 'Ships late June' are also crammed next to the button, so B's hierarchy and grouping are broken.
